stem: A pair of headphones went from €100 to €80, and its units from 50 to 70 in a period of the same length. Dividing each change by its starting value gives an elasticity of -2.0; the arc formula gives -1.5. Which statement is right?

options.text: The arc result stays the same if you go from €80 back to €100
The start-point result stays the same whichever price you start from
The two formulas always agree once the result is rounded to 1 decimal
The arc result is smaller because it counts only half of each change
